text: The relationship between obesity and mental health is complex and is moderated by the level of obesity, age, sex, and social and genetic factors. In the current study, we used a unique co-twin control design, with twin pairs discordant for body mass index (BMI), to control for shared genetic and environmental effects between obesity and several dimensions of mental health.
source_label: Mental, physical, and social well-being and quality of life in healthy young adult twin pairs discordant and concordant for body mass index
